title: Surge Bridge Contacts — Quick Grid (Jun 2026)
body:
Purpose:
A compact, one-page contact + fallback grid to use during short-lived surge events (scheduled or unplanned). This is intentionally lightweight — use it for quick routing, ping logic, and rapid escalation. Move to confluence/handbook only if this pattern repeats more than twice for the same route.

How to use: quick-check the region/route row, pick the green contact; if green is not available, escalate to backup. If both unavailable, use Escalation Tier 1 or open OPS-1124. Update availability flags as shifts change.

Key columns (in this mini-grid):
- Route: logical surface (e.g., hosted-api-us-east, embeddings-eu, dedicate-builds)
- Primary: person on shift / pager (primary contact)
- Backup: secondary contact (can be on-call, SE, or SRE)
- Region: infra/region tag
- Escalation: tier or team for next-hop
- Avail: quick status (GREEN / YELLOW / RED)
- Notes: short freeform (e.g., known cadence, ongoing work, expected downtime)

Mini-grid (comma-separated for quick paste into sheet):
Route,Primary,Backup,Region,Escalation,Avail,Notes
hosted-api-us-east,Priya Nair,Ethan Park,us-east-1,eng-sre,GREEN,Can handle limited burst; watch token queue > 8k
embeddings-eu,Maya Chen,Diego Alvarez,eu-west-1,eng-observability,YELLOW,Mini maintenance window 06/17 02:00-03:30 UTC
dedicated-gpu-apac,Diego Alvarez,Akiko Sato,ap-northeast-1,solutions-eng,RED,No spare capacity; fallback to hosted-api-us-east if latency permissible
console-rollouts,Sonia Patel,Tom Novak,global,product-console,GREEN,Can triage routing/rollout config; prefers Slack DMs
private-deploy-onprem,Anika Rao,Suresh Iyer,on-prem,customer-success,YELLOW,Customer patching window today; expect slower response

Quick counts: total routes 5; GREEN=2, YELLOW=2, RED=1. Backups assigned for 5/5 routes (100%); escalation documented for 5/5.

Open questions / TODOs:
- Confirm Akiko Sato backup contact details (phone + pager) by 2026-06-18.
- Add on-call rotation links for eng-sre and solutions-eng to each row (one-liners).
- For dedicated-gpu-apac, run capacity micro-check sheet (ticket OPS-1124) and record expected spillover capacity.

Meeting / cadence: 10min stand quick sync if a surge alert fires. Use #prod-ops for first contact; escalate to phone if silence > 8 minutes. Post-mortem only if incident meets definition (latency SLA breach > 15min or customer impact).

Last-minute notes: This grid is intentionally ephemeral — do not canonicalize in the handbook without an owner. If you copy to a sheet, add a version row (who edited + date).

Contact rotation log (quick):
2026-06-14 Priya updated primary for hosted-api-us-east (reason: shift swap)
2026-06-15 Maya set embeddings-eu to YELLOW for scheduled maintenance
2026-06-16 Diego flagged dedicated-gpu-apac RED — followup required

Where this came from: ad-hoc surge prep convo on #prod-ops (2026-06-12); follow-up RFC in OPS-1124.

If you patch this doc: append a 1-line change note at the bottom with date and initials.
